pattern: SELECT .+count\(\*\) as [a-z]+_employees FROM employee GROUP BY [a-z]+
correction: Replace 'count(*) as [column_name]_employees' with 'count([column_name])' and ensure the group by clause matches the column used for counting.

metadata.description: This rule corrects errors where the count(*) function is incorrectly associated with a column name and the group by clause does not match.
